display.purpose: Panel titles and the write-up h1.

headline.purpose: Featured project title, sized by container width.

lede.purpose: Plain sentence directly under a panel title; no kicker above the heading.

body-article.purpose: Write-ups: 1.125rem, 1.25rem from 1200px, 1.0625rem at 640px and below; max-width is the registered --measure (48ch).

label.purpose: Dial program labels, tracked caps; 800 and signal-text when current.

code.purpose: Code blocks and inline code in write-ups.

shadows.name: knob-bezel
shadows.purpose: The dial knob's turned bezel. The only shadow in the system.

motion.name: ease-detent
motion.purpose: Knob rotation onto a program; overshoots slightly and settles like a detent. Off while dragging.

motion.name: lamp-blink
motion.purpose: Lamp dims to 0.15 opacity once when the program changes.

motion.name: ring-snap
motion.purpose: Detent ring position, size and radius when snapped to a control.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation and transition durations under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Signal-filled pill for the one primary action per panel.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--signal); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 800; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f47a2f; color: var(--ink); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal-text); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined ink pill for secondary actions; inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--ink); color: var(--plate); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal-text); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Project Stops
components.description: Dashed idle and solid selected stop grammar; title only, no tag line.
components.css: .ds-stops { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; } .ds-stop { min-height: 56px; padding: 12px 14px; text-align: left; background: transparent; border: 2px dashed var(--stop-idle); border-radius: var(--radius-stop); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-stop:hover { border-color: var(--ink); } .ds-stop[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--display); border-style: solid; border-color: var(--ink); } .ds-stop:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal-text); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Display Panel
components.description: Display window on the plate: display title, plain lede, actions. No kicker.
components.html:
Loop engineering

A coding agent can work in a loop: one change per pass, a gate that has to pass, and a rule for when to stop.
components.css: .ds-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 22px; padding: clamp(24px, 3vw, 44px) clamp(20px, 3vw, 48px); background: var(--display); border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--radius-display); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font); } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem); line-height: 0.95; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.035em; } .ds-panel-lede { margin: 0; max-width: 56ch; font-size: 1.1875rem; line-height: 1.45; }

components.name: Program Dial
components.description: Knob with signal pointer that detents onto six programs with an overshoot ease; current label in signal-text.
components.html: WorkLoops
components.css: .ds-dial { position: relative; width: 240px; height: 240px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 50%; font-family: var(--font); } .ds-knob { position: absolute; inset: 26.8%; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--knob); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 12px var(--knob-ring), inset 0 0 0 13px var(--knob-edge); transform: rotate(-120deg); transition: transform var(--dur-detent) var(--ease-detent); cursor: grab; } .ds-knob:hover { transform: rotate(-72deg); } .ds-knob:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal-text); outline-offset: 6px; } .ds-pointer { position: absolute; left: calc(50% - 4px); top: 7%; width: 8px; height: 24%; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--signal); } .ds-dial-label { position: absolute; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 8px; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink-muted); } .ds-dial-label:first-of-type { left: -40px; bottom: 30px; } .ds-dial-label:last-of-type { left: -48px; top: 50px; } .ds-dial-label.ds-current { font-weight: 800; color: var(--signal-text); }

components.name: Status Strip
components.description: Sticky black strip naming the current program and linking the next one.
components.html: Work · 1 of 6Next: Loops
components.css: .ds-strip { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 16px var(--gutter); background: var(--strip); color: var(--strip-text); font-family: var(--font); font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-strip-next { min-height: 44px; margin-block: -14px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: var(--strip-text); text-decoration: none; } .ds-strip-next svg { width: 0.9em; height: 0.9em; margin-left: 0.5em; } .ds-strip-next:hover { color: var(--plate); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-strip-next:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--strip-text); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Playback Pill
components.description: Plate pill on the media corner that plays or pauses the project video.
components.css: .ds-playback { min-width: 96px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; background: var(--plate); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); font-family: var(--font); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-playback:hover { background: var(--ink); color: var(--plate); border-color: var(--plate); } .ds-playback:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal-text); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a household appliance seen face-on. A light grey plastic housing frames one rounded faceplate; on the faceplate a dark knob with an orange pointer turns between six programs, and turning it is how you move through the page. Every surface reads as a panel, display window or control on that machine: flat, tonal, edged by 1px rules, with one signal orange that behaves like an indicator lamp rather than a brand colour.

Density is moderate and calm. The type is a single grotesk, Archivo, used tight and heavy for display and tracked in caps for machine labels. Motion is mechanical: the knob detents with a small overshoot, the lamp blinks once, the cursor becomes a ring that snaps around controls like a bezel. Nothing floats, glows or casts a drop shadow.

Write-ups live on the same faceplate in a narrow reading column, so a long read still sits inside the machine and ends on the same black status strip.
keyCharacteristics: Housing, plate and display window as three tonal layers, separated by 1px rules, never by shadow.
One orange (signal) used only as fill: pointer, lamp, active tick, primary button, text selection.
One typeface, Archivo Variable, from tight 800-weight display to 0.1em tracked caps labels.
Dashed outline means "available stop", solid means "selected stop", everywhere stops appear.
A sticky black status strip names the current program and the next one.

rules.name: The Lamp Rule
rules.body: Signal orange is a fill, never text. Any orange type uses signal-text. Signal covers small indicators and the primary action only; one primary button per panel.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Orange Rule
rules.body: Text on a signal fill is ink, weight 800, never white.

rules.name: The Plain Lede Rule
rules.body: A heading is followed directly by a plain sentence: panel title then lede, write-up h1 then dek. No kicker, eyebrow or category label sits above a heading; the build has none and its tests assert none.

rules.name: The Write-up Measure Rule
rules.body: Write-ups set `--measure` as a registered custom property (`@property`, `<length>`, inherited) at 48ch, and every direct child of the article takes it as max-width. Code blocks may grow to fit their content up to the column, and blockquotes get the measure plus 96px. At 1200px and wider the measure stays 48ch while the body rises to 20px.

rules.name: The Faceplate Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never cast shadows. A new surface is a lighter inset (display) with a 1px rule, not a raised card.

rules.name: The Stop Grammar Rule
rules.body: An unselected stop is a 2px dashed outline in stop-idle; the selected stop is a 2px solid ink outline (and display fill for project stops). Dial ticks follow the same grammar: 2px dashed faint ink idle, 4px solid signal active. Hover on a stop darkens its border to ink without making it solid.

dos: Do put every new surface on the plate as a display window with a 1px rule and 18px corners.
Do use signal only as a fill and signal-text for any orange type.
Do follow a heading with a plain lede sentence.
Do draw selectable stops dashed when idle and solid when selected.
Do make every control at least 44px tall and pill-shaped if it is a button.
Do hold write-up text to the registered `--measure` of 48ch.
Do draw icons as inline SVG strokes in currentColor.
Do honour reduced motion: the detent, blink and ring transitions collapse to 1ms.
donts: Don't put a kicker, eyebrow or category label above a heading.
Don't set orange text in signal (#f2600c); it fails contrast on the plate.
Don't add drop shadows; the knob bezel is the only shadow.
Don't add a second accent colour or a second typeface.
Don't add a tag or meta line under project stop titles.
Don't show the detent ring on touch devices.
